skill.displayName: 小红书评论分析与需求挖掘

version.changelog: 澄清依赖修复的用户授权范围，优先项目或临时环境，超出已有授权的改动先说明并确认。

llm.summary: The skill coherently retrieves and analyzes requested Xiaohongshu comments, with ordinary package-update, service-privacy, and usage-cost considerations.

dimensions.detail: Node/npm, a SocialDataX API key, and service requests fit the purpose. Optional --all collection has no default item cap, while --pages and --max-items provide limits.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The disclosed npm dependency and three @latest commands create update-related supply-chain exposure, but do not establish malicious behavior. The public [package manifest](https://github.com/DevinChen2014/socialdatax-skills/blob/main/package.json) matches the named CLI and declares no install lifecycle scripts; registry release contents were not verified.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Queries target user-supplied posts, default to the first page, and preserve requested collection limits; environment repairs require appropriate user authorization.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact requests no background workers, persistent behavioral changes, browser/session access, or elevated privileges; the API key is explicitly supplied through the environment.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: Comment and reply retrieval directly supports the stated analysis purpose; no unrelated collection or account mutation is instructed.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Use a reviewed, pinned package version where possible. SocialDataX receives the lookup IDs, links, or share text you submit, so exclude unrelated sensitive information. Set page or item limits to control collection and API-credit costs. The read-only description concerns account actions and does not sandbox the npm program.
llm.findings:
[RP1] expected: The three advisory occurrences identify the same unpinned CLI dependency. This warrants version-pinning guidance, but the artifact shows ordinary, disclosed package execution rather than evidence of a compromised package or hidden payload.
[SQP-2] expected: The artifact names SocialDataX, its API-key provider, and the submitted lookup parameters. Sending those inputs to the named service is expected for retrieval; there is no instruction to upload unrelated private content.
